care_tips.text: Stop using the watch and keep it away from anything that can burn if the battery swells, gets very hot or smells unusual.
care_tips.why: A damaged battery can catch fire.

care_tips.text: Don't open, puncture or crush the battery, and don't use it after a hard fall that dented it.
care_tips.why: Damaged battery cells can overheat or catch fire.

care_tips.text: Switch the watch off and unplug the charger before cleaning it.
care_tips.why: Cleaning a charging device risks a short circuit.

care_tips.text: Charge it only with its own charger.
care_tips.why: The wrong charger can damage the battery.

care_tips.text: Check your manual before swimming or showering with it, and avoid saunas and hot water.
care_tips.why: Water resistance has limits and weakens with age.

care_tips.text: Wipe the sensors, contacts and strap regularly.
care_tips.why: Dirt gives wrong readings and stops charging.

care_tips.text: Install updates for the watch and its app.
If it stops charging or water gets inside, contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: These can be signs of a fault.

reminders.text: Clean the watch's sensors, contacts and strap.
reminders.note: Check your manual for the interval for your model.
